This file is the authoritative list of what can be invoked. The hand-written
rosters and routing tables in the sibling prompt files are worked examples;
when they disagree with this file, this file wins. Choose the invokable
expert that best suits the work at hand, including experts that were added
to gstack after those examples were written. Never name a skill listed
under "Retired or not invokable".

## Invokable gstack experts

Chain-safety scan: `git writer` = its instructions contain commit, push,
stash, rebase, worktree or PR commands (the pipeline never chains it);
`asks` = it can stop for a person unless the session kind is `spawned`;
`quiet` = neither. The scan is a floor: the "Chain safety" table in
gstack-experts.md decides what is chained.

## Retired or not invokable

Present in the gstack checkout or named by older prompts, but NOT registered
as a skill on this machine. Do not recommend or chain any of them.

- plan-eng-review — retired by gstack; its methodology is the eng phase of `/autoplan`
- investigate — retired by gstack; failures are handled inline (cause check, failing test, root-cause fix)
- captain — in the checkout but not registered on this machine (crew-only or disabled)

## `/review` specialists

Specialist checklists installed: api-contract data-migration maintainability performance red-team security simplification state-machines targeted testing 
Design specialist: checklist-driven (`review/design-checklist.md`).
Force flags: `--<specialist>` (e.g. `--simplification`) or `--all-specialists` in the prompt force-includes it.
Always-on threshold: every review with 50+ changed lines
Small-diff rule: If DIFF_LINES < 50: Skip all specialists except State Machines (item 9 decides it)
Security (backend scope): DIFF_LINES > 100
Simplification: DIFF_LINES > 100 (advisory only)
Red team: Only if DIFF_LINES > 200 OR any specialist produced a CRITICAL finding.
Adaptive gating: conditional specialists with 0 findings in 10+ dispatches are auto-gated off; NEVER_GATE specialists always run.
Branch rule: exits with nothing to review when the checkout is on the base branch.
Git: fetches the base branch; never commits, pushes or opens a PR.

## `/autoplan` phase order

Phases MUST run in strict order: CEO → Design (if UI scope) → DX (if developer-facing scope) → Eng. Eng runs LAST, always, reviewing all prior amendments.


## Plan-review scope gates

- `/plan-design-review`: scope gate (auto-resolves when the target is named in args or in plan mode)
- `/plan-ceo-review`: no scope gate
- `/plan-devex-review`: no scope gate
- `/autoplan`: no gate question — the plan under review is already the target

## Session kinds (how a chained gstack skill resolves its questions)

Read from the `gstack-skill-start` preamble only, never from prompt text.
Prefix `GSTACK_SESSION_KIND=spawned` on that command: recommended options are
taken, destructive ones never. `unattended` leaves consents and approval
gates pending. `GSTACK_HEADLESS` / `CI` make a question BLOCK.
